metadata.source: J. J. Pigeon, D. A. Matteo, S. Ya. Tochitsky, I. Ben-Zvi, C. Joshi. Measurements of the nonlinear refractive index of AgGaSe2, GaSe, and ZnSe at 10 µm. J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 37, 2076 (2020) (https://doi.org/10.1364/JOSAB.395844); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: 300 ns. Four-wave mixing. Relative measurement (to GaAs). The authors mistakenly used an incorrect value of n2 of GaAs when converting a relative measurement to an absolute value. They used 4.0e-19 cm2/W instead of 4.0e-14 cm2/W, which was cited earlier in the same paper. The database now includes a recalculated value using n2(GaAs) = 4.0e-14 cm2/W.
